Format Premiere - Coruscant: posted 10 August 2001 and the list uses Coruscant-set cards (objective, Watto's Junkyard, Neimoidian Advisor, Security Battle Droid, Destroyer Droid, Gardulla The Hutt).
Watto's Junkyard, Mos Espa, Podrace Arena, Cantina, Marketplace and Boonta Eve Podrace dested to the Dark printings for this Dark deck.
Posted 'Tatooine (Ep 1)' dested Tatooine (Dark) (Coruscant), the Episode I printing of the system.
Posted 'Maul' dested Darth Maul (Tatooine); the card titled Maul is a later Virtual card.
Posted 'Collision' x3 dested Podracer Collision, the Dark Tatooine podrace interrupt (Collision! is a Light card); the deck races.
Posted 'Nemoidan Advisor' dested Neimoidian Advisor; 'Command' dested Imperial Command; 'Maul's Stick' dested Maul's Lightsaber; 'EPP Vader' dested Darth Vader With Lightsaber.
Posted 'We Must Make Our Stuff Faster' matches no card; printed as posted (UNKNOWN).
